scope: Independent in-memory JSON replay, guarded failure cases, original-source spans and static schema/consumer inspection. No application imports, runtime, tests, builds, network, browser or mutations.
integrationNotes: B is required after A-FTN before describing the FTN current narrative as corrected. A alone deliberately retains the old maker-arranged text.

Reapplication fails closed on exact before-row guards; it is duplicate-safe, not a successful no-op. A future applier must distinguish already-applied from conflicting drift without appending history again.

The contract requires exactly one full identity match. Current IDs are globally unique and count invariance is verified; a future applier should also reject any concurrent duplicate stable ID/family identity, even if its other identity fields differ.
The new roadRegistrationStatus string has no enum or consuming branch in inspected app source/scripts/tests; compatibility is static metadata compatibility, not a typecheck/runtime approval.
Persisted sourceArtifacts and boundedSourceReview pointers refer to workspace research files, as existing conventions do. They are audit provenance, not verified public downloadable URLs.
Source-review completion, zero closed exact builds and availability/catalogue eligibility remain separate dimensions. Do not treat the new fields as release or ranking approval.
